d:
Collection of Harimao's Pixiv Castlevania /Bloodstain stuff rom their Twitter and Pixiv.

I also included the free Skeb sets and thumbnails for the paid ones that I don't have

Like Beruzumi M's Castlevania stuff, Vincent Dorin is a recurring character I can't tag, where he has vampire powers due to his vampirism and mind controls in some of these images and Graham Jones is the dude in some of the later ones.

The Artist's Fanbox/Fantia has extra versions, some unique sets I don't have here and dialogue versions of some of these sets.

Some of these originate from nijie.

2 of these are from Skeb, hence the large "SAMPLE" text.

Artist's Pixiv: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/129911
Artist's Twitter: https://twitter.com/morgan_zero02
Artist's Skeb: https://skeb.jp/@morgan_zero02
https://nijie.info/members.php?id=77867

Let me know if I missed anything non-fanbox. (My god, there's alot of it)

"ミイラ女 （出現地:熱砂の砂漠）
一体のみ出現する。誰かを呼ぶようなうめき声を上げている…
魔法を使ってくるため油断ならないが、倒すと【しん・ぶぐじてん】を確定ドロップする。
炎に弱いためとっとと荼毘に付してしまえ！" -454, description of the image from the original twitter post.

"適性高いのにあまり見ないザッキーノ
魔術は使えないが薔薇に何か仕込んである…⁉
二枚目はおっさんの顔見たくない人用です" -455-456, Description from original twitter post.

"元・ヴァンパイアハンターが変性したとされるサキュバス
新米ハンターを次々に骨抜きにしている危険度S＋の悪魔
「サバトしましょ…？」" 430-431, Description from original twitter post.

550-551 was in a duo with a set that is definitely Castlevania, I'm not experience with every Castlevania game so I'm not sure if these area actually Castlevania characters but I figured it would make sense to include it since they're in the same post just in-case. https://soloharimao.fanbox.cc/posts/8409219409219
